description: This file defines a utility object 'SaleCountdownFormatter' with a method 'formatRemaining' that formats remaining milliseconds into a human-readable countdown string, either 'H:MM:SS' or 'M:SS'.

classes.name: SaleCountdownFormatter
classes.description: Utility object for formatting remaining duration into a compact countdown string.

methods.name: formatRemaining
methods.description: Formats remaining milliseconds into a string, either 'H:MM:SS' if >= 1 hour, 'M:SS' if less than an hour, and '0:00' for null or non-positive input.
